description.value: Small Victory is a family-owned artisan bakery and café whose founders trace their roots to a Kenyan immigrant bakery started by their parents on West Broadway. The Yaletown location sits on Marinaside Crescent, steps from the False Creek seawall — one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors — making it a natural stop for riders. The menu runs from handcrafted sourdough loaves and laminated pastries to full brunch and lunch offerings including sandwiches, power bowls, and specialty coffee sourced from local roasters.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 28m; stands (7 spaces) at 50m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record maps to the Yaletown – Marinaside Crescent location of Small Victory Bakery, which is explicitly listed on the website with a matching address (1089 Marinaside Crescent, Vancouver, BC V6Z 2Z4) and phone (604-336-6025). The website confirms 'Indoor Dining + Takeout' for this location and lists a lunch menu with sandwiches, bowls, a vegan option, and a gluten-friendly cake. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website footer displays the Mount Pleasant location address (388 West 6th Avenue) as the primary contact address, which could cause confusion; the Yaletown-specific details (1089 Marinaside Crescent, 604-336-6025) are confirmed in the locations section and match OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active artisan café on the False Creek seawall cycling corridor with confirmed takeout, a substantial lunch menu, and vegan/GF options — a clear benefit to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes 'Vegan Chickpea Masala Sandwich', 'Mango Coconut Cake (Gluten Friendly)', and multiple plant-based items (Avocado Toast, Spinach & Feta Turnover, Spring Edamame & Quinoa Power Bowl)

wow_evidence: family-owned artisan bakery and café whose founders trace their roots to a Kenyan immigrant bakery
